description: Python bindings for Harper, the offline English grammar checker written in Rust
rules: Import from `harper`; the PyPI name is harper-py.
Create one `harper.Linter()` and reuse it: construction loads the dictionary.
Spans are Python str indices: text[lint.span.start:lint.span.end] == lint.problem_text.
The API mirrors harper.js's Linter in snake_case; lint options are keyword arguments (language, regex_mask, force_all_headings, dedup, isolate_english).
